name: Lemon-Caper Spaghetti with Tofu, Asparagus, Bell Pepper & Parsley

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sprinkle each tofu plank with salt on both sides and sandwich between clean towels or paper towels; place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (340 g) pkgs extra firm tofu
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes; drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
3 orange bell peppers
3 lemons
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces and place in a large bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; add to the bowl with the asparagus and set aside.
Cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles; place in another large bowl. Sprinkle with flour and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp all-purpose flour
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; working in batches if necessary, add tofu and cook until golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve pot for later use.)
When the tofu is done, return the pot to medium heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and additional flour; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice half of the lemons into the pot; add broth, capers, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until the sauce has thickened, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve remaining lemons for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
6 tbsp capers
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce is cooking, cut the remaining lemons into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add asparagus and bell pepper to the pot with the sauce; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, add drained pasta and parsley to the pot; toss to combine and continue to cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes more.
To serve, divide pasta, veggies, sauce, and tofu between plates or bowls. Squeeze lemon over top and enjoy!
